description: Projects and their components (named parts of a project). list: projects (by status). create: names are unique. update: rename, describe, or set status (archived retires it). list_components / add_component / update_component: the same for components (deprecated retires one). delete / delete_component: deletes it with its child records after a safety copy; the answer includes the undo identifier. create and delete wait for the user's approval when approvals are on (the item then appears in the review queue, and the answer's next line names it). Reads: list, list_components. Returns project or component rows, or what was deleted.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

component_id.description: update_component / delete_component: the component's id (list_components shows ids).

description.description: create / update / add_component / update_component: what it is.

model.description: Model name if known. Unknown names are omitted.

name.description: create / add_component: the new name (required, unique). update / update_component: a new name.

parent_component_id.description: add_component: a parent component in the same project.

project.description: Every action but list and create: the project, by name or id.

status.description: list: only this status. update: active, paused, completed or archived. update_component: planning, in_progress, testing, complete or deprecated.

name: manage_projects
